{{Quote|I have three bounties on Lok I haven't had a chance to collect. You take care of them for me, and I'll split the bounty with you.|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BBP" />}}
'''Joti Laike''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] hitman who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he moved to the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to try his luck at [[Nym's Stronghold]] after a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] was placed on his head.<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> Nevertheless, In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Balfur Jhcor]] localized Joti Laike on Lok. Bossk later proposed to a spacer encountered on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to split the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]]. The adventurer therefore traveled to Lok and tracked the assassin to Nym's Stronghold. The spacer attacked Joti Laike and finally killed him.<ref name="SWG:BBP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Joti Laike was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Joti Laike was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
